summary: The interview resolved the sole material issue-time decision in one focused question, and the contract faithfully captures the selected general safe-repr behavior, intentional raw-string output change, preservation of explicit and callable IDs, shared setup/teardown path, all three existing setup-display modes, repository helper reuse, and targeted validation. Hindsight shows the gold patch also quoted generated IDs and chose maxsize=42, but those are diagnostic implementation differences rather than misses against the sealed owner decision; the exact limit was not an issue-time requirement.
